result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal carousel content is awkwardly clipped and the fixed bottom navigation visibly covers the restaurant feed.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the lower restaurant card, obscuring a substantial portion of its image and potentially its details while scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation height plus the device safe area so the final cards can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: The category row shows only a thin, unlabeled fragment of the next chip at the right edge, which looks like accidental overflow.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or carousel inset so a meaningful portion of the next chip is visible, or clip the row cleanly.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is heavily cut off, including its restaurant name, without a clean truncation treatment.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths and carousel side padding, and apply an ellipsis to names within each card’s own bounds.
